title: BMC Engine Sequencing with Graph Neural Network Embeddings of Hardware Circuits
problem: Formal verification via Bounded Model Checking (BMC) requires engine selection and sequencing; traditional approaches lack intelligent switching between engines at different verification depths.
motivation: Different BMC engines perform better at different verification depths; intelligent selection can improve overall verification performance.
method: Use GNN embeddings of hardware circuits (via DeepGate2 tool) to drive BMC engine selection strategy. Learns to switch between engines at different depths based on circuit structure.
key_novelty: Application of neural circuit embeddings (GNN) to guide BMC engine sequencing; demonstrates feasibility of ML-guided formal verification.
contributions: GNN-based circuit representation learning for BMC
Integration with DeepGate2 for circuit embeddings
limitations: Abstract only; no quantitative results on speedup or verification time improvements; specific benchmark results not provided; no discussion of scalability to industrial designs.
